say: Na farko, yawa: yawancin igiyoyi suna girma a kan fatar kan mutum. Yi wani bangare a kambi, gashin gashi, haikali da nape, kuma ga nawa fatar kan mutum ya nuna. Temples sau da yawa sun fi bakin ciki.

say: Na biyu, faɗin madauri. Rike gashin da aka zubar kusa da zaren dinki. Sirara fiye da zaren gashi mai kyau, wanda ke karyewa cikin sauƙi kuma yana buƙatar ƙarancin ƙara nauyi.

say: Misali, Amaka a Enugu yana da abokin ciniki, Funmi, wanda ke son ƙananan kulli marasa tsayi don bikin aure. Gashin Funmi yana da kyau, tare da siraran haikali.

say: Don haka Amaka yana ba da shawarar ƙwanƙwasa matsakaici mara ƙarfi a tsakiyar tsayin baya, ba tare da ƙarin gashi a haikalin ba, da ƙarin lokacin bushewa saboda gashin yana da ƙarancin porosity. Funmi har yanzu tana samun gyalenta, gwargwadon girman gashinta.

say: Duba fatar kan mutum da haske mai kyau kafin a jika ko tsefe. Farin flakes masu haske ba tare da ja ko zafi ba? Ku yi hidima, kuma ku lura da shi akan katinta.

cards.d: Farin fari mai haske, babu ja, babu zafi. Tsaftace a hankali sannan ka lura da shi akan katin ta.
Lice ko nits, zagaye ƙwanƙolin faci tare da karyewar gashi, maƙarƙashiya ko raunuka. Kada ku yi hidima a yau.
Ƙananan gefuna: babu tashin hankali a can. Yanke ko danyen fata: babu sinadarai, kuma kar a yi mata sutura.

say: Lace ko ƙwai, zagaye ɓawon fuska mai karyewar gashi, maƙarƙashiya ko raunuka? Kada ku yi hidima a yau. Faɗa mata abin da kuka gani a ɓoye kuma ku ba da shawarar ma'aikacin lafiya. Kada a taɓa gano cutar.

say: Ajiye katin sirri don kowace ziyara: cikakkun bayananta, cak ɗin ku, tarihinta, salon da aka amince, lokaci, farashi, ajiya, da izinin hoto. Ga yaro, iyaye sun yarda.
Ka sake karantawa ka tambaye ta ta amsa ta amince ta WhatsApp.

say: Don tunawa. Yi duban hudu a kowane ziyara, saboda gashi yana canzawa. Gashi mai kyau da gefuna na bakin ciki suna buƙatar ƙarancin nauyi. Dakata da koma cikin sirri. Tsaftace kowane kayan aiki. Kuma sanya lokaci da farashi a rubuce.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Duba yawa, faɗi, porosity da elasticity
Gashi mai kyau da gefuna na bakin ciki: manyan sassan, ƙananan nauyi
Dakata da komawa; bayyana a keɓe, kar a taɓa tantancewa
Jaka da tsaftace kowane kayan aiki wanda ya taɓa matsalar fatar kan mutum
Bayyana lokaci daga matsakaicin naku, a rubuce

say: Yanzu yi aiki. Tantance kawuna uku, gina katin duba fatar kanku da jerin masu ba da shawara, kuma ku gudanar da shawarwari guda biyu.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Ayyukan aikin ku
items: Tantance kawuna uku da cika katunan uku
